text:
frank: Quick notes from today's UX sync on the starter-journey — trying to keep this thread short.

meera: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/staging/starter-journey-v1 (frames: header-pill, full-takeover, sample-grid). Main ask: avoid pushing content off-screen on smaller viewports.

devon: Proposed pattern: header pill (collapsed) that expands into a full hero only when focused or tapped. On desktop it can auto-expand after 2s idle. On mobile always collapsed to save height.

andie: Accessibility: when the hero expands, we need aria-live to announce "onboarding options" and move focus into the dialog region. If collapsed, the pill must be reachable via keyboard as the first tabbable header item.

frank: Copy tweak: current headline "Welcome — get started" feels fluffy. Suggest "Create your first project" for clarity. CTA options: "Use sample" or "Create empty".

meera: For sample cards, add a 1-line intent label like "example" or "production-ready" plus an aria-describedby hook with that line. Also prefer "Use sample" over "Try sample" (less transient).

devon: Behaviour Q: what happens when users dismiss? Should we hide forever or show a small "Welcome" icon in header? I vote for persisted dismiss + header re-open icon for discoverability.

andie: Persist skip server-side. If a user starts setup but abandons, surface a "Resume setup" entry in the Help menu for 7 days. If they explicitly skip, hide until they click the header icon.

ux-bot: staging deploy succeeded: starter-journey-pill @ commit d4f7a9 — available at https://staging.redwood.dev (visuals live).

meera: Contrast check: primary CTA (white on purple) is ~3.7:1 on hero. We need 4.5:1. Options: darker purple or change to dark text on light button. Devon, can you try the darker tint?

devon: Yep I'll run color variations + submit screenshots. Also will gate behind flag: starter_pill_v1 for beta orgs; telemetry stubbed until launch.

frank: Measurement: track onboarding.pill_viewed, onboarding.expanded, onboarding.sample_selected, onboarding.skipped with props { variant, sample_id, viewport }. Run experiment for 250 starts or 10k pageviews.

andie: QA checklist: keyboard focus order, aria-live announcement on expand, focus return on close, contrast fixes, touch target >=44px on mobile.

meera: Decision summary: implement header-collapsed pill (auto-expand on desktop idle), persist skip server-side, add header re-open icon, change sample CTA to "Use sample", fix CTA contrast to AA, and track events. Assigning tickets to devon (impl + colors) and andie (a11y + QA). I'll update the ticket and attach acceptance criteria. Thanks all!
